scoring: Exact edge tuples are source-memory/receipt-local. Required omissions and unsupported extras are counted separately; allowed edges do not count as extras. A malformed or failed slot is not empty and is not a complete case.

cases.note: Explicit reason supports adopted choice within one receipt.
Changed noise premise does not replace pump.
Only price is challenged; endpoint granularity cannot represent the independent key-location reason.
Consideration is not adoption; shared calendar topic is insufficient.
Tentative leaning and ambiguous referent do not establish a decision or challenge.
Explicit new decision has its own reason; neither premise is challenged, and replacement has no wire type.
Blue color elaborates, not challenges, seat-height reason.

Both receipts explicitly reaffirm the same adopted choice and reason. Any one support covers the decision; repeated valid supports are allowed, so this case tests relation type and scope rather than minimal edge precision. Later corroboration supporting the earlier decision does not claim the later message caused the past choice; no challenge is supported.
Only Mina/Juniper premise is challenged. Hazel belongs to another actor and has no challenged premise.
Historical lunch choice was adopted then, not a current decision; assistant advice and thanks do not adopt a new cafe. Same-memory move cannot be represented as a challenge to that same memory.
